seo_title: Peacock Teal Paseo Mosaic Bathroom Tiles
meta_description: Peacock teal paseo tiles in glazed ceramic: a rounded, flowing shape for bathroom feature walls, vanity backs and niches. Free sample on WhatsApp.
description:
These peacock teal paseo tiles are glazed ceramic mosaic pieces in the paseo shape, an elongated outline with rounded ends, made for bathroom feature walls, vanity backs and shower niches.

## How they look
Paseo shape tiles have a stretched, pebble-like form with curved ends, so the rows tend to flow across a wall instead of forming a hard grid. Peacock teal is a deep blue-green that can lean more blue or more green as the light changes through the day. The glaze gives the colour depth and a sealed face.

## Where they work
- **A feature wall** behind a basin, bathtub or mirror.
- **Shower niches** and a band at eye level in the shower.
- **Powder rooms and guest washrooms**, where one strong colour suits a small space.

Teal bathroom wall tiles pair well with white, brass or black fittings and a plain light floor. Rounded mosaic tiles like these are a wall tile; for floors, ask about Pak Clay's flatter mosaics.

## Good to know
- Material: glazed ceramic mosaic
- Colour: peacock teal
- Shape: paseo
- Category: bathroom wall mosaic tiles
- Size and sheet layout: confirm on enquiry

Plan where the pattern stops at the top edge and corners before setting, as the curved ends need careful cutting. Use your tiler's advice on adhesive, grout and waterproofing in wet zones.

## See it before you order
Pak Clay shows its range at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) and at G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) and hold it up in the bathroom where it will go, then get a dated quote. Compare it with the [teal blue fish scale mosaic](/products/glazed-color-teal-blue-fish-scale-ceramic-mosaic-bathroom-wall-tiles) or browse the [bathroom wall mosaic range](/categories/bathroom-wall-tiles-mosaic).
ai_summary: Pak Clay's peacock teal paseo mosaic is a glazed ceramic wall tile with an elongated, round-ended shape, made for bathroom feature walls and shower niches. Free samples are available on WhatsApp, with showrooms in Lahore and Islamabad.

faqs.q: What is the price of paseo mosaic tiles in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the quantity, the area to cover and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.
Paseo is a tile shape: a long piece with rounded ends, a little like a stretched pebble. Laid in rows it gives a soft, flowing pattern.

faqs.q: Paseo or fish scale tiles: which suits a small bathroom?
faqs.a: Both work on one feature wall. Paseo reads calmer and more linear; fish scale is busier and more decorative. In a very small room, the calmer paseo pattern usually feels less crowded.

faqs.q: Can I see a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with "Peacock Teal Paseo Mosaic" and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
